title: Proposed study collaboration on Tay-Sachs disease

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on Tay-Sachs disease
Dear NTSAD, CATS Foundation and Cure Tay-Sachs Foundation team, each of you works with families affected by Tay-Sachs disease.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would welcome your thoughts on a study idea.
Published work describes a hexosaminidase A deficiency in which GM2 ganglioside builds up in nerve cells.
Protein misfolding is also suggested, with lower confidence, because a chaperone partly rescued many variants in patient cells.
A natural history study of the gangliosidoses is recruiting, and the status of the Gangliosidoses registry is unknown.
Pyrimethamine and N-acetyl-L-leucine trials have completed, one miglustat trial was terminated, and an intrathecal gene therapy is in clinical testing.
We would propose [study aim and design], shaped with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your community or the natural history study could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call at a convenient time?
